title: Demos and presenting your work
intro: In a demo, guide the client step by step: share your screen, say what they're looking at, and pause for questions.
introNative: Demo में client को step by step guide करें: अपनी screen share करें, बताएँ कि वे क्या देख रहे हैं, और सवालों के लिए बीच-बीच में रुकें।

phrases.text: Let me share my screen. Can you see it now?
phrases.native: मैं अपनी screen share करता हूँ। क्या अब आपको दिख रही है?
phrases.note: Always check that the client can see your screen.

phrases.text: As you can see here, the order status updates automatically.
phrases.native: जैसा कि आप यहाँ देख सकते हैं, order status अपने-आप update होता है।
phrases.note: Point to what matters on the screen.

phrases.text: I'll walk you through the new approval flow.
phrases.native: मैं आपको नया approval flow step by step दिखाता हूँ।
phrases.note: "Walk you through" means explain step by step.
Pause after each main part to check understanding.

phrases.text: This is test data, so the numbers aren't real.
phrases.native: यह test data है, इसलिए ये numbers असली नहीं हैं।
phrases.note: Say this early so the client doesn't worry about strange values.

steps.prompt: You're about to start a demo on a Teams call. What do you say first?
steps.promptNative: आप Teams call पर demo शुरू करने वाले हैं। सबसे पहले आप क्या कहेंगे?
options: Screen is coming? Visible or not?
Let me share my screen. Can you see it now?
I am sharing, you see.
steps.answer: Let me share my screen. Can you see it now?
steps.explanation: Say what you're doing, then check that it worked.
steps.explanationNative: बताइए कि आप क्या कर रहे हैं, फिर check कीजिए कि वह ठीक से हुआ या नहीं।

steps.promptNative: मैं आपको नया approval flow step by step दिखाता हूँ।
steps.answer: I'll walk you through the new approval flow.

steps.audioText: As you can see here, the order status updates automatically.
options: As you can see here, the order status updates manually.
As you can see here, the order status updates automatically.
As you can see here, the order history updates automatically.
steps.answer: As you can see here, the order status updates automatically.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Now I will show you the updation in the dashboard.
options: Now I will show you the updation in the dashboard.
Now I'll show you the update to the dashboard.
Now I will show you the updations in dashboard.
Now I will be showing the updation of dashboard.
steps.answer: Now I'll show you the update to the dashboard.
steps.explanation: "Updation" isn't a standard English word; say "update".
steps.explanationNative: "Updation" standard English word नहीं है; "update" कहें।

steps.prompt: You've finished showing the first screen. How do you check in with the client?
steps.promptNative: आपने पहली screen दिखा दी है। अब आप client से कैसे check-in करेंगे?
options: Understood or not?
Any questions so far?
Is it clear for everybody or any doubts?
steps.explanation: A short, open question invites feedback without sounding like a test.
steps.explanationNative: एक short, open सवाल से feedback मिलता है, और यह test लेने जैसा नहीं लगता।

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: Kindly ignore the values, it is a test data.
options: Kindly ignore the values, it is a test data.
Please ignore the values; this is test data.
Kindly ignore values, these are test datas.
Please ignore the values, it is a dummy datas.
steps.answer: Please ignore the values; this is test data.
steps.explanation: "Data" is uncountable, so say "this is test data", not "a test data".
steps.explanationNative: "Data" uncountable है, इसलिए "this is test data" कहें, "a test data" नहीं।

steps.promptNative: यह test data है, इसलिए ये numbers असली नहीं हैं।
steps.answer: This is test data, so the numbers aren't real.

steps.audioText: Let me share my screen. Can you see it now?
options: Let me share the screen. Can you see the mouse?
Let me stop sharing my screen. Can you see me now?
Let me share my screen. Can you see it now?
steps.answer: Let me share my screen. Can you see it now?

steps.prompt: Think of a feature you built recently. Out loud, start a short demo in 3–4 sentences: share your screen, walk the client through one screen, and check for questions.
steps.promptNative: हाल ही में आपने जो feature बनाया, उसके बारे में सोचिए। 3–4 sentences में बोलकर एक छोटा demo शुरू कीजिए: अपनी screen share करें, client को एक screen walk through कराएँ, और पूछें कि कोई सवाल है या नहीं।
